parameters.query:
with alvo as (
  select o.id from public.outbound_contatos o
  where o.telefone = $1
    and o.etapa in ('aguardando_resposta','em_conversa','sem_resposta','reuniao_agendada','no_show')
  order by o.created_at desc
  limit 1
)
update public.outbound_contatos o
set etapa = 'desqualificado', proximo_fup_em = null, erro = null, updated_at = now()
from alvo
where o.id = alvo.id
returning o.id, o.campanha_id, o.id_externo, o.nome, o.mailing_id, o.telefone;

with alvo as (
  select o.id from public.outbound_contatos o
  where o.telefone = $1
    and o.etapa in ('aguardando_resposta','em_conversa','sem_resposta','reuniao_agendada','no_show')
  order by o.created_at desc
  limit 1
)
update public.outbound_contatos o
set etapa = 'desqualificado', proximo_fup_em = null, erro = $2, updated_at = now()
from alvo
where o.id = alvo.id
returning o.id, o.campanha_id, o.id_externo, o.nome, o.mailing_id, o.telefone;
